titleEn: Condo Renovation Cost in Vancouver 2026: Real Budgets $8K–$120K
contentEn:
Condo renovation costs in Vancouver in 2026 range from $8,000 for a cosmetic refresh to $120,000+ for a full gut-rehab. Most mid-range projects fall between $25,000 and $75,000. Three factors drive the final cost: scope of work, finish level, and strata compliance requirements.

Condo Renovation Cost by Project Type

A kitchen renovation in a Vancouver condo costs $20,000–$45,000 for a full gut-rehab with new cabinetry, quartz countertops, and updated plumbing. A full bathroom gut-rehab runs $12,000–$27,000. A complete condo renovation — kitchen, bathroom, flooring, and trim — averages $50,000–$75,000 in Metro Vancouver. Cosmetic-only updates start from $8,000.

What Drives Your Condo Renovation Cost

Building age is the first cost variable. Condos built before 1990 often contain Poly-B plumbing pipes — any pipe work requires a licensed plumber and adds $2,000–$8,000. Electrical panel upgrades in older buildings run $1,500–$4,500. Strata approval for cosmetic work is typically 2–4 weeks; structural or plumbing work can reach 6–10 weeks.

Finish level is the largest variable. A mid-range kitchen with laminate countertops and builder-grade fixtures costs 40–60% less than a kitchen with custom millwork, natural stone, and premium appliances. Mid-range kitchens in Vancouver typically run $20,000–$35,000; premium kitchens with Miele or Wolf appliances can reach $55,000–$75,000.

Condo Renovation Permits and Strata Approval

Cosmetic work does not require strata approval. Any work involving plumbing, electrical, structural changes, or common property requires strata approval and a Vancouver building permit. Reno Stars includes strata application handling as part of our standard project scope.

Condo Renovation FAQs

How much does a condo renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A mid-range bathroom gut-renovation in a Vancouver condo typically costs $12,000–$27,000. A full kitchen renovation with new cabinetry and quartz stone countertops runs $20,000–$45,000. A complete condo renovation including kitchen, bathroom, and all flooring typically costs $50,000–$75,000. Cosmetic-only updates start from $8,000.

Do I need strata approval for a condo renovation in Vancouver?

Cosmetic work does not require strata approval. Any project involving plumbing, electrical, structural changes, or common property requires strata approval and a Vancouver building permit. Your contractor should handle the strata application process.

How long does a condo renovation take in Vancouver?

A single bathroom renovation takes 3–5 weeks. A full kitchen renovation takes 5–8 weeks. A complete condo renovation from permit approval to handover typically takes 8–14 weeks. Strata approval adds an additional 2–6 weeks before work begins.

2026年溫哥華公寓裝修成本由僅cosmetic刷新的$8,000到全套gut-rehab的$120,000以上。中檔項目通常在$25,000至$75,000之間。三個因素決定最終成本：工程範圍、選材檔次，以及分契規要求。

按項目類型的公寓裝修成本

溫哥華公寓廚房裝修，採用新櫃檯面，石英石檯面並更新管道的全面拆舊工程，收費通常為$20,000–$45,000。全套浴室拆舊工程收費為$12,000–$27,000。整間公寓裝修——廚房、浴室，地板和飾面——平均收費為$50,000–$75,000。僅cosmetic的更新起價$8,000。

計劃在大溫哥華地區進行公寓裝修？聯繫聚星裝修獲取免費、無義務報價——我們的團隊已在溫哥華、列治文、高貴林、本拿比和素里完成公寓項目。

什麼影響公寓裝修成本

樓齡是首個成本變量。1990年前建造的公寓通常含有Poly-B管道——任何管道工程需要持牌水管工，額外增加$2,000–$8,000，老樓宇的電錶升級費用為$1,500–$4,500。僅cosmetic工程的分契審批通常為2–4週；涉及結構或管道工程在有爭議記錄的樓宇可達6–10週。

選材檔次是最大變量。採用層壓板檯面和建築檔次固定裝置的中檔廚房，比配備定制細木工、天然石材和高檔電器的優質廚房便宜40–60%。溫哥華中檔廚房通常收費$20,000–$35,000；配備Miele或Wolf電器的優質廚房可達$55,000–$75,000。

公寓裝修許可與分契規

僅cosmetic的工程不需要分契審批。任何涉及管道、電氣，結構變更或公共財產的工程均需分契審批和溫哥華建築許可。聚星裝修將分契申請流程作為標準項目範圍的一部分。

公寓裝修常見問題

2026年溫哥華公寓裝修多少錢？

溫哥華公寓單間浴室gut-rehab通常收費$12,000–$27,000。配備新櫃檯面和石英石的全面廚房裝修收費$20,000–$45,000。包括廚房、浴室和所有地板的整間公寓裝修通常收費$50,000–$75,000。僅cosmetic的更新起價$8,000。

溫哥華公寓裝修需要分契審批嗎？

僅cosmetic的工程不需要分契審批。任何涉及管道、電氣，結構變更或公共財產的工程均需分契審批和溫哥華建築許可。您的承包商應處理分契申請流程。

溫哥華公寓裝修需要多長時間？

單間浴室裝修需時3–5週。全套廚房裝修需時5–8週。整間公寓裝修從許可審批到交接通常需8–14週。分契審批在工程開始前額外增加2–6週。
